hemoglobin_low: Palak (spinach), rajma, pomegranate, dates, sesame seeds, beetroot. Pair iron-rich foods with Vitamin C (lemon, amla) for better absorption. Cook in iron kadhai.
glucose_high: Avoid maida, white rice, sugar, soft drinks, fruit juices. Eat methi (fenugreek), karela (bitter gourd), brown rice, oats, dal, whole wheat roti. Walk 30 min daily.
hba1c_high: Low glycemic diet. Replace white rice with brown rice or millets (bajra, jowar, ragi). Add cinnamon and methi to tea. Eat daliya, oats, sprouts. Exercise 30 min daily.
cholesterol_high: Reduce ghee, butter, fried snacks, samosas. Use olive oil or mustard oil. Eat oats, walnuts, flaxseed, garlic. Add soluble fiber: rajma, chana.
triglycerides_high: Avoid sugar, refined carbs, fruit juice, alcohol. Eat omega-3 rich flaxseed, walnuts. Reduce rice portion. Add fish if non-vegetarian.
hdl_low: Exercise regularly (brisk walking 45 min, cycling). Eat walnuts, almonds, flaxseed, olive oil, avocado. Include coconut in moderation.
ldl_high: Reduce saturated fats (ghee, butter, paneer, cream). Eat soluble fiber: oats, rajma, chana. Use mustard oil. Add garlic to cooking.
uric_acid_high: Avoid red meat, organ meats, shellfish, alcohol, mushrooms. Drink 3+ litres water daily. Eat cherries, low-fat dairy, cucumber, coconut water.
tsh_high: Eat iodized salt, eggs, fish, dairy, coconut oil. Avoid excess raw cruciferous vegetables (cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower) and soy products.
vitamin_d_low: Get 20 min morning sunlight daily (before 10 AM, arms and face exposed). Eat fortified milk, eggs, mushrooms. Consider D3 60,000 IU weekly for 8 weeks.
vitamin_b12_low: Eat eggs, dairy, paneer, curd, buttermilk. If strict vegetarian, take B12 supplement (methylcobalamin 1500 mcg daily). Eat fortified cereals.
iron_low: Eat palak, rajma, chana, jaggery, dates, amla, pomegranate. Cook in iron kadhai. Take with lemon/orange for Vitamin C absorption. Avoid tea with meals.
creatinine_high: Reduce protein intake temporarily. Stay well hydrated (2-3L water). Avoid NSAIDs. Eat cucumber, lauki (bottle gourd), palak, coriander.
bilirubin_high: Drink plenty of water and fresh sugarcane juice. Avoid oily/fried foods. Eat papaya, radish, lemon water. Rest adequately.
